definition: Joseph (Yossi) Keshet (Hebrew: יוסף (יוסי) קשת; born: 28 February 1973) is an Israeli professor in the Electrical and Computer Engineering Faculty of the Technion, where he is the director of the Speech, Language, and Deep Learning Lab.
details: His research focuses on human speech processing and machine learning.

explainer.lead: Joseph Keshet is an Israeli professor of Computer Science. His work spans computer science.

contributions.name: Another research led by Keshet suggested that it is possible to fool structured AI systems (like Google Voice).
Keshet is the founder and chair of the Machine Learning for Speech and Language Processing Special Interest Group (SIGML) of the International Speech Communication Association (ISCA), from 2011.

timeline.what: He graduated from the Amal School and began his academic studies at the Department of Electrical Engineering-Systems at Tel-Aviv University in 1991 and received his B.Sc.
Keshet served in the IDF Unit 8200 from 1995 to 2002 as the head of the speech processing research section in the R&D Center.
Keshet was award his M.Sc. from the same department after he completed his Israel Defense Force service in 2002.
He continued his Ph.D. studies at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem until 2008.
Joins Technion – Israel Institute of Technology
